resources.string: No active SIMs are readable. Grant phone status access and refresh. Inactive profiles require additional framework access.
Power policy excludes NR. Battery Saver can cause this even when user and carrier settings allow 5G. Review Battery Saver yourself; UltimateIMS does not change power policy.
The readable user network mask excludes NR. Review preferred network type in Android settings.
The readable carrier network mask excludes NR. Carrier provisioning or policy may restrict 5G.
NR policy diagnosis is incomplete: one or more masks are not readable. Battery Saver alone does not prove NR is excluded.
All three readable policy masks allow NR. This does not prove NR registration, SA access, modem support, or VoNR calls.
Endpoint values are read from SettingsProvider. NetworkStack may prefer resource overlays; a stored URL does not prove it is the active probe. No network probes are sent by this build.
No analytics, ads, telemetry, cloud uploads, remote code loading, or automatic privileged startup. SIM identifiers are not displayed or logged.
Status read failed; values remain unknown.
Data RAT, IMS registration, capabilities, and display icons are separate observations. This build does not establish the radio technology of an active voice call.
Draft only. Keep unchanged fields are never written.
Apply %1$d selected changes to %2$d selected SIMs? Original values are backed up first. Carrier restoration verifies effective values; it cannot prove exact override-layer deletion.
Start and authenticate a selected backend to apply device changes.
Load a preset into the draft
Enable persistent VoLTE for this SIM
Disable persistent VoLTE by restoring originals
Subscription VoIMS opt-in and advanced-calling user values are separate from CarrierConfig reapply. VoNR is not changed incidentally. Reboot/call behavior must be verified on your firmware.
Load a history entry as a draft
Request IMS restart for this SIM
This can interrupt calling. Continue for the selected SIM? Override deletion cannot be independently verified; reset will pause automatic reapply and retain recovery backups.

Override the selected SIM region with the fixed three-digit draft? Other apps reading SIM region may change behavior. MCC/MNC will not be changed. This does not guarantee TikTok access or internet connectivity.
Opt in: reapply saved carrier changes when the selected backend is ready
This never starts Shizuku, pairs ADB, or requests root automatically. It is separate from persistent VoLTE. Unknown results pause reapply.
Connect local wireless ADB and start private backend

Enable Wireless debugging in Android Developer options. Enter the pairing port and six-digit code shown under Pair device with pairing code. The connection port on the main Wireless debugging page is different. Only this device is accepted.
Review and apply portal endpoint draft
Change device-wide HTTP/HTTPS validation endpoints? Endpoint hosts can see probe requests. Stored-value verification does not prove NetworkStack uses the new endpoints.
Open APN settings for this SIM
Reviewed APN profiles require a matching verified SIM operator. Existing profiles are retained; changing mobile data requires confirmation.
Invalid draft or operation refused. Details are in the local status log.
This sends a request to the endpoint you enter using the current default network. The host can see your IP. Reports remain local. No connection or call is interrupted.
Select backed-up fields to restore. Backups remain after restoration.
No verified original-value backup for this selection
An operation is in progress or the remote result is uncertain.
Default Wi-Fi calling preference (0 Wi-Fi only, 1 cellular, 2 Wi-Fi)
Advanced calling user value (-1 unset, 0 off, 1 on)

Change only this verified SIM. This may interrupt mobile data. Add a separately identified profile and select it after saving the original preferred APN; restoration preserves existing profiles and removes only the app-owned row. Firmware permissions may refuse this operation. T-Mobile roaming uses IPv4/IPv6; ask your carrier if IPv4-only is required.

Enter an HTTPS service that returns one plain-text IP address. This service will see your connection IP. Use the current default network; a VPN may change the observed exit. The address is displayed locally and excluded from diagnostic exports.
Allow editing the advanced LTE setting
Hide the advanced LTE user setting
Allow editing the Wi-Fi calling preference
Allow editing the roaming Wi-Fi calling preference
Bind reviewed draft to selected SIM
Confirm this draft is intended for the currently selected SIM. This only binds the draft for later review and application; it writes no device settings.
Packet service is registered on NR, indicating SA data registration. This does not establish the technology of a voice call.
LTE packet registration with a connected secondary NR is observed, indicating NSA. Display icons remain a separate observation.
NR registration is unknown or not established by the current observations. A 5G icon or enabled setting alone cannot establish it.

Android 17 gates local networking with a system permission. Grant it explicitly, then tap Pair or Connect again. UltimateIMS keeps private ADB connections on 127.0.0.1 and does not scan LAN devices. Permission alone does not start pairing or a backend.
IMS registration, voice over 5G (VoNR), and LTE/5G radio controls for the selected SIM.
Connect your selected backend here, then configure Wi-Fi calling, preferences, and advanced options.
Understand registration and connectivity. Settings and icons are separate from an actual connection.
Review system-wide connectivity check endpoints. Changes here affect every SIM and Wi-Fi.
Persistent VoLTE, original-value recovery, and advanced maintenance. Review each operation before continuing.
System appearance, language, privacy, and app information.
Optional Material You colors from your wallpaper, in both light and dark themes.
Enter comma-separated numbers. Changes are validated before saving.
This value is saved to a draft first.
A privileged connection is needed to read or apply these settings.
Switches prepare changes. Review and apply when ready; they do not prove registration or a working VoNR call.
Theme follows your system automatically on launch and when the system changes.
